key_insight: MedGuards uses multiple LLM agents plus confidence-based arbitration to detect, locate, and correct medical text errors more reliably than single-step heuristic checks.
clinical_relevance: It could improve the safety of clinical note generation and editing by reducing harmful medical text errors without retraining the base model.
method: Specialized agents handle detection, localization, and correction as separate steps.
A confidence-guided arbitration step resolves disagreements using reasoning traces and confidence scores.
Introduces KPCS, a metric that rewards correct generation of critical medical keywords.
evidence_signal: The approach was evaluated on four multilingual clinical-note datasets and reported significant gains across multiple models and metrics.
watch_item: Performance may still depend on prompt design, confidence calibration, and the quality of the underlying LLM outputs in new clinical settings.
paper_title: MedGuards: Multi-Agent System for Reliable Medical Error Detection and Correction
